== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Planet Defender Ion Cannon (Japanese)|Planet Defender Ion Cannon]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/157878145/8p6rGJQGK0KixgMzTmU5vg.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 91317483.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>55363efa75cd90c7d8a4b95dafc1c108ce3e674f5876899576456f4ccaa200da</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
